bullets.title: AVGO: $285B rout on AI guidance disappointment; stock down across sectors
bullets.body: Broadcom's FY2Q26 AI revenue surged 143% YoY to $10.8bn but Q3 guidance of $16bn+ disappointed elevated buy-side expectations, sparking a broad semiconductor selloff. Erste Group upgraded AVGO to Buy post-earnings, while European semis paused after a 50% rally. ARK also bought 14,190 AVGO shares on the dip. CEO pivoting from acquisitions to organic AI growth; FY2027 $100bn AI chip revenue target reiterated.

bullets.title: CIEN: Strong F2Q26 beat; analysts bullish but stock down on valuation at 65x NTM EPS
bullets.body: Ciena delivered F2Q revenue of $1,571M (+40% YoY, $70M above guidance), raised FY26 guide to $6.2-6.4B from $5.9-6.3B, and grew backlog to $7.7B (+50% YoY). Won first hyperscaler multi-rail order with ramp starting 2027; TAM expected to double to ~$50B by 2029. Analysts bullish: Citi Buy at $658, Wolfe Outperform at $660, JPM Overweight at $635, Stifel Buy at $615. UBS reiterates Neutral citing 85x NTM EPS vs. 5yr avg 24x. Stock down on valuation concern, not fundamentals.

bullets.title: NVDA: Senate testimony invite, HBM4 supply secured, Jensen hints at surprises in Seoul
bullets.body: Senator Warren invited CEO Jensen Huang to testify before Senate Banking Committee on June 11 on export controls and China chip sales. NVIDIA completed HBM4 approvals from all three major memory makers (Samsung, SK Hynix, Micron) for Vera Rubin supply. Separately, Rubin NVL72 SOCAMM memory content cut 50% from 55TB to 28TB due to rising memory costs. Jensen Huang on Korea visit hinting at upcoming surprises, meetings with Hyundai, Samsung, SK Group, and plans for R&D center.

bullets.title: AAPL: WWDC Jun 8-12 — Siri overhaul and edge AI catch-up; fwd P/E at multi-year highs
bullets.body: Citi and Jefferies both characterize WWDC as an AI catch-up moment rather than breakthrough; major Siri overhaul expected to feature Google Gemini integration and agentic workflow enhancements. AAPL's 2.5B installed base uniquely positioned for edge AI monetization via software, developer tools, and services. Strong Mac Mini demand from agentic AI use cases signals early hardware traction. AAPL fwd P/E approaching multi-year highs per market-ear.

bullets.title: RBRK: Strong F1Q27 beat; ARR +32%, identity doubles to $50M; analyst day June 10 catalyst
bullets.body: Rubrik reported Q1 revenue of $387M (+39% YoY, above Street $366M), ARR of $1,565M (+32.5%), and operating margin of ~6% vs Street -6%. FY27 ARR guidance raised to $1,854-$1,862B from $1,829-$1,839B. Identity ARR doubled to $50M in 2 quarters; cloud mix at 89%. Roth raises PT to $107, Mizuho to $90, Wolfe to $95, all Outperform/Buy. Analyst day June 10 expected to be positive catalyst.

bullets.title: APP: Upgraded to Outperform at Edgewater, +3% pre-market; full self-service launch imminent
bullets.body: Edgewater Research upgraded AppLovin to Outperform; stock up ~3% pre-market. Jefferies highlights APP's full self-service platform launch expected this month, with e-commerce revenue projected to grow from 10% of FY25 revenue to 30% in FY27. JPMorgan notes AppLovin as clearest AI-native disruptor in digital advertising. Morgan Stanley's SMID-Cap internet team lists APP as top 2H pick.

bullets.title: CVNA: Citi and JPM both bullish post Elyria IRC tour; 3M unit target achievable in 4-6 years
bullets.body: Both Citi (Buy, $93 PT) and JPMorgan maintain bullish views after touring Carvana's Elyria IRC. ROLLCALL/LEADERHUB/CARLI software stack driving material reconditioning cost benefits and throughput gains. May web traffic accelerated to +61% YoY. Management's 3M retail unit sales target seen achievable in 4-6 years vs. prior 4-9 year guidance. ADESA Clear expanding 3P dealer access.

bullets.title: ADBE: Citi cautious into earnings (Jun 11); pricing headwinds, weak AI adoption
bullets.body: Citi lowers FY26 ARR growth estimate to 9.5% vs. 10.2% guidance and FY27 to 8% vs. consensus 9.5%, citing pricing benefits turning into headwinds in 2H26 and weak AI adoption. Web traffic decelerated in F2Q; discounting for Creative Cloud Pro grew to 50% vs. 40% earlier. Raised PT to $264 from $253 driven by software multiple uplift. KeyBanc similarly cautious on muted marketing demand and generative AI competitive pressure.

bullets.title: ORCL: Earnings Jun 10; KeyBanc models another 200+ bps OCI beat; OCI to be 43% of FY27 revenue
bullets.body: Oracle stock up 62.7% YTD vs. software index +25% on infrastructure strength. KeyBanc models $69.3B FY27 capex vs. consensus $71.4B, expects 43% of FY27 revenue from OCI (up from 27% in FY26), and sees another strong cloud revenue beat. Middle East deal risks have diminished; partner sentiment improved post-May deescalation. Earnings consensus: $19.1B revenue, $1.96 EPS.

bullets.title: META: Mizuho raises PT to $835; WhatsApp Business Agents could be largest growth driver since mobile
bullets.body: Mizuho raises META PT to $835 following expert call on 'Conversations 2026.' Business AI Agents full global launch earlier than expected; SMB adoption within 6-9 months. WhatsApp Business Discovery monetizable search layer could generate ~$40B ad revenue in 2026 growing ~50%. Expert views the platform opportunity at hundreds of billions annually over 5-10 years, potentially larger than current ad business. ARK bought 40,078 META shares on Thursday.

bullets.title: NET: Cloudflare investor day catalyst; agentic traffic surpassed human traffic; KeyBanc models 19.7% FY27 op margin
bullets.body: Cloudflare shares up 34.6% YTD. Agentic traffic on Cloudflare network just surpassed human traffic (57.5% bot/AI vs. 42.5% human). KeyBanc models FY27 operating margin at 19.7% vs. consensus 16.6%; CFO to discuss long-term operating model changes post-restructuring. Workers AI platform and security suite seen as core AI beneficiaries.

bullets.title: CRDO: Jefferies H2 top pick; AEC franchise in early innings, 2nd hyperscaler qualification key catalyst
bullets.body: Jefferies maintains CRDO as one of two top 2H picks. AEC (active electrical cable) franchise in early innings with 30-40% market growth expected; qualification of 2nd hyperscaler is the key near-term catalyst. TSMC CoWoS capacity raised to 180kwpm for 2027, widening supply-demand gap by 15-20%, which benefits CRDO's positioning.

bullets.title: U (Unity): MS Overweight at $35; conversion gap closure could grow ad revenue 4-5x
bullets.body: Morgan Stanley maintains Overweight on Unity with $35 PT. Runtime data improving scale and quality; no 2Q contribution yet. Ad conversion rates materially below peers—closing the gap could grow ad revenue 4-5x. China Create growing >40%; Meta competitive risk may be overstated. Edgewater also upgraded Unity to Outperform.

bullets.title: SNOW: Opco raises PT to $295; CoCo/CoWork monetization inflection, AI GTM accelerating
bullets.body: Oppenheimer raises Snowflake PT to $295 following Snowflake Summit. Platform pivoting to Agentic AI with strong data governance differentiation. 60% of customers planning >20% YoY spending; 75% increasing Cortex Code use. Jefferies also lists SNOW as H2 top pick with CoCo/CoWork monetization as the inflection driver. Maintains strong partner relationships with Anthropic, OpenAI, AWS, Google, and Microsoft.

bullets.title: CRWV/NBIS: Multiple desks flag Great American AI Act of 2026 as win-win catalyst
bullets.body: A sales desk note flagged by multiple desks indicates the Great American AI Act of 2026 is expected to formalize imminently and positions CRWV (CoreWeave) and NBIS as primary beneficiaries. Both names were under pre-market pressure (-2.1% and -3.7% respectively) in the broader semi selloff.

bullets.title: TSM: Visibility extends to 2030; chairman warns against aggressive memory-style pricing
bullets.body: TSMC chairman C.C. Wei states demand visibility extends to 2030, well beyond typical foundry horizons, driven by AI demand that surprised 'even Nvidia CEO Jensen.' Targeting mid-30% YoY revenue growth for current year. High-NA EUV purchased from ASML but still in research phase, not mass production. Chairman explicitly stated desire to avoid aggressive pricing like memory chip market. CoWoS capacity raised to 180kwpm by 2027 per Jefferies.

bullets.title: MRVL: Jensen Huang calls it 'next trillion-dollar company'; MRVL up 187% since congressman's buy
bullets.body: NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang publicly called Marvell 'the next trillion-dollar company' at Computex. MRVL up 187% since Rep. Byron Donalds (AI subcommittee member) purchased shares. Jefferies maintains MRVL as part of its semiconductor coverage with updated models. Morgan Stanley West Coast Semiconductors Bus Tour scheduled June 10-11 featuring Marvell.

bullets.title: Jobs Friday macro setup: consensus +88k NFP, 4.3% unemployment; risk-off above 120k
bullets.body: Consensus expects ~88k payroll growth (JPM internal estimate 75k), stable 4.3% unemployment, and 0.3% MoM AHE. 22V Research flags a regime shift: strong payrolls are now risk-off given inflation-constrained environment, with the risk-off threshold at NFP >120k. Options market pricing ~1.0% S&P move. Futures pre-market: Nasdaq -1.13%, S&P -0.6%.

bullets.title: ROKU: Piper reiterates Outperform at $148; home screen refresh = $500M+ annual revenue opportunity
bullets.body: Piper Sandler estimates ROKU's home screen refresh could generate $500M+ in annual revenue at ~90% gross margins, representing a 2027 catalyst. World Cup and USA 250 provide additional political ad tailwinds. Stock reiterated as Outperform with $148 PT.

bullets.title: CRM: KeyBanc reiterates OW at $290; Agentforce use-cases compelling but enterprise adoption uneven
bullets.body: Salesforce Connections 2026 showcased strong agentic automation with internal Agentforce handling 100% of prospecting calls and Live Nation resolving 85% of fan inquiries. Three new Agentforce products launched including Coworker powered by Claude Opus. However, manufacturing and industrials remain skeptical; AI adoption varies significantly by industry. CRM trades at 4.2x CY26 EV/revenue vs. sector average 5.7x.
